canonical_expansion.level: macro rows; guard rows name operational probes
canonical_expansion.row_encoding: canonical compact JSON object plus LF

pattern_language.head_arity: bounded left-spine walk expanded without a runtime counter
pattern_language.holes: independent opaque subtrees; repeated display names are not equality tests
pattern_language.parent_pattern: move U, inspect displayed nodes, and move back through the known incoming side
pattern_language.path: compile-time finite word over L/R, expanded to one-edge moves
pattern_language.probe_exit: every success and ordinary pattern failure restores the origin

primitive_probe_expansion.level: origin-restoring local-observation and one-edge cursor states
primitive_probe_expansion.row_encoding: canonical compact JSON object plus LF

probe_expanded_controller.level: macro guards replaced by primitive probe programs; finite register actions remain explicit control rows
probe_expanded_controller.row_encoding: canonical compact JSON object plus LF

semantics.compression_rule: all exponents are compile-time constants and expand to distinct states
